decisions.decision: Decision history is NOT fully tamper-evident: verify_integrity/tamper-detection never compare current decisions[] against decision_created audit snapshots; only the audit_log hash chain is verified
decisions.context: Verified in core/tropebook/web/server.py:4469-4670. #52 fixed the audit log chaining (write-time SHA-256, genesis), but decisions themselves carry no stored hash and structure-only checks (duplicate/malformed 12-hex IDs, empty text, timestamp order) pass even when decision text/context/risk_level is edited directly in memory/tropelex.json. SAFETY.md's 'immutable decision history' claim is only half true.

decisions.decision: No authentication on any write path: core/auth/ JWT middleware (require_auth/optional_auth) exists but has zero usages; any local process can write decisions, forge overrides, and overwrite .env API keys via POST /api/settings/apikey
decisions.context: Verified by grep: no endpoint uses the JWT deps. Rate limiter explicitly skipped for localhost (server.py:92). /api/settings/apikey docstring says 'localhost only' but contains no client-IP check. MCP server and OpenCode plugin send no token (X-Tropelex-Client is self-reported). No Host-header validation = DNS rebinding residual. Self-reported agent_name makes override accountability forgeable.

decisions.decision: Prioritized adversarial-hardening recommendations: (1) instance auth token + Host validation, (2) decision-level write-time hashing verified against audit snapshots, (3) audit _apply_persona_market_escalation mutation path, (4) extend injection screening to all context-read memory fields
decisions.context: Delivered in 2026-08-16 repo analysis. Tier 1 (close verified gaps, moderate effort): auth write surface (defeats 'any local process can do anything' class), decision hashing (makes immutable-history claim true, reuse core/audit.py compute_hash), audit persona-market escalation (same class #61 audited on contradictions side), screen goals/session summaries/preferences/alignment_considerations (sentinel currently covers 5 markers, decision+context only). Tier 2: LLM intent-falsification check (flag-only, budgeted, dry-run), wire real diffs into dead /ghost-decisions, Drift-Bench CI. Tier 3: lifecycle-event gates, session safety budget #73-4, poisoning anomaly detector, schedule agent-audit.

decisions.decision: _apply_persona_market_escalation (server.py:2507) mutates requires_review/escalation_reason/risk_level with NO audit event and fires from GET /reviews/pending — same mutation class #61 audited on the contradictions side
decisions.context: Verified: grep for append_audit_event in the 2500-2545 range returns nothing; the function saves memory in place. GET /reviews/pending is a side-effectful read. Asymmetry: contradictions router escalation writes contradiction_escalated events, persona/market escalation writes nothing. Also the path #57's incident showed could mass-escalate 53 decisions on a live project.

decisions.decision: Live detection asymmetry: GET /{project}/ghost-decisions hardcodes empty diff_data (dead code); scheduler ghost scan is diff-less; only the preventive ghost-check receives real diffs
decisions.context: Verified in core/ghost/router.py — 'For now, use an empty diff_data list' comment. The documented 'silent drift detection' surface structurally cannot detect anything; all live detection is on-demand through ghost-check. Rewarding attack class (Drift-Bench 0% on reward hacking, #67 semantic layer dry-run-rejected) remains undefended in the post-hoc path.

decisions.decision: Intent-falsification check design: LLM entailment judgment (does this diff falsify the decision's intent) as a second-stage rescue after keyword matching finds nothing — NOT similarity; flag-only with severity cap, never block alone; gated by Drift-Bench + live-corpus dry-run (pre-registered acceptance criteria) before wiring; budgeted via existing ReasoningClient/providers + core.cost.tracker; backward-compatible slot in match_decision_to_diff
decisions.context: Mapped 2026-08-16. Grounded in: _reward_hacking_positive (driftbench/scenarios.py:214-235, decision 'Never bypass authentication for admin-level access' vs backdoor diff 'if user.email == debug@internal.test: return True'), #67 dry-run (cosine 0.29 TP vs 0.65 benign typo fix — no threshold), existing LLM infra (core/last30days/lib/providers.py ReasoningClient/OpenAIClient + generate_json, core/cost/tracker.py). Entailment works where similarity failed because the LLM reasons about the specific code pattern (early return before permission check) instead of matching vocabulary. Preserves repo discipline: #57 no untuned signal into escalation, #67 dry-run before wiring, backward-compat optional params. V1 scope: code diffs only; diff content treated as untrusted data; uncertain is first-class.

decisions.context: Subtask 05 of reposeek-mvp feature. Created reposeek.js as a standalone IIFE module and added research-view to index.html with desktop nav, mobile bottom nav, and the full Repo Seek section (scan button, loading spinner, results table, error states). decisions.decision: Repo Seek MVP: scan-only button in Research tab that finds similar GitHub projects based on Tropelex project memory. No user input form (deferred to v2).
decisions.context: Scope simplified from multi-source meta-search with user input form to a single scan button. User input form, multiple data sources, trending data, and LLM profile building all deferred to phase 2. On-demand only, no caching. GitHub API with 3 parallel search calls (query, language, topics), deduplication, scoring (language overlap 0.3, topic overlap 0.3, stars 0.2, description overlap 0.2). Top 10 results.
